title: Harden the namespace-lookup allocation gate in harness 236 against future hoisting
description: From eu-oaz72.94 (PR #1184) review. Target namespace-lookup reads str.len("ab"), which does not depend on the loop variable; a future let-floating or CSE pass could hoist it and the allocation budget would pass vacuously. Make the read depend on the loop variable (e.g. str.len(str.of(i))) and re-verify by fault injection in both dispatch paths, blob mode.
close_reason: Landed in PR #1314 (merged): 012_arith divides-precedence checks and the loop-dependent read in harness 236, both fault-injection verified.

title: Harness: show that ∣ / ∤ bind at :eq precedence, not :cmp
description: Non-blocking follow-up from both rig-reviews of PR #1167 (eu-oaz72.68). The arithmetic topic tests don't distinguish :eq from :cmp precedence for the divides operators. Add a check whose result differs between the two (e.g. mixing ∣ with < or = in one expression), fault-injected by temporarily changing the metadata.
acceptance_criteria: A gating check fails when ∣'s precedence is :cmp and passes at :eq.
close_reason: Landed in PR #1314 (merged): 012_arith divides-precedence checks and the loop-dependent read in harness 236, both fault-injection verified.

title: Tidy after native-storage move: dedupe backing mark/forward helpers, try_with_data duplication and wrong overflow size
description: Non-blocking review findings on eu-oaz72.5 (PR #1138): the backing-buffer mark/forward code is repeated in set.rs, ndarray.rs, string.rs, env.rs and cont.rs (scan_primitive_array/update_primitive_array vs scan_scalar_array/update_scalar_array) and could be one Array helper; RawArray::try_with_data repeats with_data, its .expect on an already-NonNull pointer is unreachable, and its overflow error reports usize::MAX/isize::MAX where the real cap is u32::MAX bytes (4 GiB per container, now an error not a panic: document it). GC area, two independent reviews.
close_reason: Landed in PR #1308 (merged, two reviews): one backing mark/forward helper, single try_alloc path, real overflow cap documented.
